about: Places that are never shown, by OSM ref (user rules 20 Oct 2026: no friteries, no student / university cafés, cafeterias or restaurants; 26 Oct 2026: no pizza places, no kebab / döner / shoarma / gyros / pita shops). import_osm.py skips these OSM elements and merge_venues.py skips these venue ids, so they do not come back on re-import. Use this when the name/tags do not match never_kind() in import_osm.py. 'pizzaKebabKeep': OSM refs that the pizza/kebab rule in import_osm.pizza_kebab_kind() would drop but that are kept (unclear evidence).
